I answered Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team: the store was **Pine Crossing**.

That comes from her own post in #central-team on Jun 9, during the Marrow Agrisupply rollout escalation. She wrote that Pine Crossing's morning receiver said the appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift. A driver who arrived at 7:10 was logged on a sticky note instead. Hollis replied that he'd check the shift template.

Nothing later in the channel says it was fixed, so I suggested she check before marking it resolved in the account sheet.

Pree is a member of #central-team, so I only used what she can already see. I checked the knowledge brain first, then confirmed the answer in that channel. The reply doesn't include any money terms or anything from direct messages, so no approval was needed.
